deadline.value: No closing date for research degrees; two registration periods (1 September and 1 March), most start in September. Apply early: supervisory capacity is limited. Funded project adverts set their own deadlines.
deadline.quote: No closing dates apply for application for higher degrees by research but there are only two registration periods (September and March). Applicants are advised to apply as early as possible prior to their chosen registration period as supervisory capacity may be limited.

also.quote: The School accepts applications from talented and hardworking candidates all year round.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: Get a potential supervisor's approval first; the formal application link is sent only after a supervisor offers you a place
supervisor.quote: You will need to get approval from a potential supervisor before making a formal application.

also.quote: Following contact with your potential supervisor/professor, if you are offered a place, you will be given a link to the admissions website through which you will need to make a formal application.

funding.value: Most students are funded (fees + stipend) by national/international bodies, usually tied to specific projects; unfunded applicants must win funding (e.g. IRC, TCD/School studentships, which are extremely competitive). Some funded adverts are restricted to EU/EEA/UK applicants.
funding.quote: The vast majority of our students are supported by national or international funding bodies, providing both College fees and an annual stipend. | For truly exceptional candidates the School of Physics can provide financial support. These positions are extremely competitive and only a few awards are made every year.

also.quote: Some projects are associated with grants, perhaps from SFI or the EU, which pay a student's fees and a stipend. Others do not and rely on the student applying for funding.

entry_route.value: Minimum 2.1 honours (bachelor's) degree or equivalent; a first or a master's is an advantage. Students go directly on the PhD register or start on the Masters register and transfer. Equivalence of a 3-year Indian BSc is not stated.
entry_route.quote: The minimum entry to our postgraduate program is a 2.1 honors degree from an Irish university or equivalent.

also.quote: A general minimum requirement for PhD entrants is the applicant must have a Second Class Honours Grade I (a II.1) or higher Bachelors degree
Research students are placed either directly on the Ph.D. register or on the Masters register.

notes: PhD normally takes about four years; start dates 1 September or 1 March. Funded projects are advertised on the School's postgraduate page (adverts there on 2026-10-21 were from 2024-25). Fee status (EU vs non-EU) affects tuition, so check each advert's eligibility.
